failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS mon,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN 1 END) AS orders_2017,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN 1 END) AS orders_2018,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN 1 END)
         - COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN 1 END) AS growth_abs,
       ROUND(
         (COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN 1 END)
          - COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN 1 END))::numeric
         / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN 1 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY mon
LIMIT 12

failures.question: 每个州的平均配送时长是多少天？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM shipments s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 100;

  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_value

failures.question: 当前等级与最近一次会员快照等级不一致的会员有多少？按等级组合统计。
failures.generatedSql:
select
  m.level_id as current_level_id,
  mlc.level_name as current_level_name,
  ms.level_id as snapshot_level_id,
  mls.level_name as snapshot_level_name,
  count(*) as member_count
from members m
join (
  select member_id, level_id
  from (
    select member_id, level_id,
           row_number() over (partition by member_id order by snapshot_date desc, snapshot_id desc) as rn
    from member_snapshot
  ) t
  where t.rn = 1
) ms on ms.member_id = m.member_id
left join member_levels mlc on mlc.level_id = m.level_id
left join member_levels mls on mls.level_id = ms.level_id
where m.level_id is distinct from ms.level_id
group by m.level_id, mlc.level_name, ms.level_id, mls.level_name
order by member_count desc
limit 100

failures.question: 默认收货地址所在州和客户登记州是否一致的订单量对比，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.state = c.customer_state THEN 1 END) AS matched_orders,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.state <> c.customer_state THEN 1 END) AS mismatched_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY total_orders DESC
LIMIT 20

failures.question: 运费占 GMV 的比例是多少？按宏观区域拆解。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT r.macro_region,
       SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight_value,
       SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv_with_freight,
       SUM(oi.freight_value) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 0) AS freight_ratio
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON c.customer_state = r.region_code
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 100;
